capabilities: Draw arrows between identifier-marked points in a note
Customize arrow color, opacity, type, x-position and arrowheads
Connect one start point to multiple end points
Navigate between matching arrow identifiers by clicking
extras: Works only in Live Preview mode; relies on the leader-line JavaScript library to render arrows.
problem: Obsidian has no way to visually connect related parts of a note with arrows, as you would when annotating a printed page.
summary: Syntax-based plugin that draws arrows between marked points in a note's margin, like annotating on paper, in Live Preview.
